description: Source code for API routes related to job applications in a FastAPI backend. Defines API endpoints for candidates to apply and view applications, and for employers to view applicants and update application statuses, utilizing SQLAlchemy ORM models and JWT-based authentication.

classes.name: ApplicationBase
classes.description: Pydantic model representing basic application data, including an optional cover letter.

classes.name: ApplicationCreate
classes.description: Extends ApplicationBase to include job identifier, used for creating a new application.

classes.name: ApplicationRead
classes.description: Extends ApplicationBase to include application details for reading, such as ID, status, and timestamps.

classes.name: ApplicationStatusUpdate
classes.description: Model for updating the status of an application.

classes.name: CandidateBrief
classes.description: Summary of candidate info including ID, email, and optional profile details.

classes.name: ApplicationWithCandidate
classes.description: Combines application information with an embedded CandidateBrief for employer views.

methods.name: get_current_user(db: Session = Depends(database.get_db), token: str = Depends(oauth2_scheme))
methods.description: Retrieves the current authenticated user from the JWT token.

methods.name: apply_for_job( application: ApplicationCreate, db: Session = Depends(database.get_db), current_user: models.User = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Allows a candidate to apply for a specified job if not already applied and the job is active.

methods.name: list_my_applications( db: Session = Depends(database.get_db), current_user: models.User = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Returns a list of applications submitted by the current candidate.

methods.name: get_my_application( application_id: int, db: Session = Depends(database.get_db), current_user: models.User = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific application for the current candidate.

methods.name: list_applicants_for_job( job_id: int, db: Session = Depends(database.get_db), current_user: models.User = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Allows an employer to view all applicants for a job they own, with candidate profile info.

methods.name: update_application_status( application_id: int, status_update: ApplicationStatusUpdate, db: Session = Depends(database.get_db), current_user: models.User = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Allows an employer to update the status of a specific application.
